entries.title: NVIDIA expands supply chain commitments to support AI infrastructure growth
entries.paragraph_1: According to the Company's press release, working with Amkor Technology, Foxconn, Kinsus Interconnect Technology, Samsung Electro-Mechanics, Siliconware Precision Industries (SPIL) and TSMC, NVIDIA is expanding manufacturing capacity across substrates, advanced packaging, wafer and contract manufacturing to scale production of its current and next-generation accelerated computing platforms. Our supply chain is a strategic advantage, said Debora Shoquist, executive vice president of operations at NVIDIA. Our work with these partners builds on our manufacturing foundation for long-term growth, expanding capacity across components, advanced packaging and system production to deliver the accelerated computing platforms our customers need. NVIDIA is expanding its substrate supply commitments with Kinsus and Samsung Electro-Mechanics, adding manufacturing capacity and improving production capabilities at existing factories. Under a new agreement with NVIDIA, Kinsus plans to expand its advanced ABF package substrate manufacturing capacity dedicated to NVIDIA by more than 3.5x over current levels from its Youth campus in Taoyuan, Taiwan. As per the press release, production is expected to begin in the second half of 2027, with the additional capacity targeted for the third quarter of 2028. This multiyear agreement builds on the companies existing supplier relationship and supports NVIDIAs long-term supply planning for its accelerated computing platforms. We believe AI will be one of the most important technology transitions of our lifetime, said Scott Chen, CEO and president of Kinsus. After more than a decade of partnership with NVIDIA, we are excited to continue building the future together. NVIDIA and Samsung Electro-Mechanics have amended their existing substrate supply agreement to improve operational capabilities at existing factories in support of increased production of NVIDIAs accelerated computing platforms. The amendment builds on the companies previously announced multiyear collaboration supporting substrate manufacturing in Sejong and Busan, South Korea, for NVIDIAs compute and high-speed networking technologies. By combining our world-class substrate fine-processing technology and high-reliability MLCC technology, we will perfectly fulfil our role as a total solution provider so that NVIDIAs AI platform can be supplied to the global market on time, with the highest performance and quality, said Duck-Hyun Chang, CEO of Samsung Electro-Mechanics. NVIDIAs advanced packaging plans include a new capacity expansion with SPIL and previously announced agreements supporting Amkors manufacturing expansion in the U.S. and South Korea. NVIDIA is supporting Amkors expansion of advanced packaging capacity in Arizona and South Korea through multiyear agreements announced in July and October 2026, totalling nearly $3 billion. The agreements include prepayments to help Amkor scale manufacturing capacity for NVIDIAs long-term production needs. Our agreements with NVIDIA support investments in Arizona and South Korea that will serve multiple generations of AI platforms, said Kevin Engel, president and CEO of Amkor. That long-term planning allows us to advance our packaging technologies and add manufacturing capacity as NVIDIAs production needs grow. NVIDIA and SPIL are expanding advanced packaging operations in Taiwan under a multiyear agreement supported by multibillion-dollar funding from NVIDIA. The expansion will increase contracted advanced packaging capacity dedicated to NVIDIA by mid-2029. The project includes new production lines with turnkey support spanning bumping, interposer wafer fabrication, assembly and testing. These capabilities support semiconductor products with demanding requirements for computing performance, bandwidth, power efficiency and system integration. SPIL is proud to strengthen our collaboration with NVIDIA, said C.W. Tsai, CEO and chairman of the board of SPIL. This agreement enhances our ability to support nextgeneration packaging technologies and deliver the performance and reliability required for future AI systems. The third quarter marked the first volume shipment of NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 and Vera CPUs for agentic AI. These products take advantage of TSMCs 5nm, 3nm and CoWoS advanced packaging technologies. TSMC and NVIDIA share a longstanding partnership built on semiconductor innovation, said Dr. Kevin Zhang, senior vice president and deputy co-COO at TSMC. This deep collaboration allows us to plan for future technology requirements and prepare our manufacturing capabilities as NVIDIA brings new platforms to market. Foxconn continues to deepen its collaboration with NVIDIA across next-generation GPU and networking platforms, said Young Liu, chairman of Foxconn. By leveraging its integrated global production network spanning Asia, North America, and Europe, Foxconn is well-positioned to support the volume ramp-up of next-generation AI infrastructure. These commitments build on NVIDIAs decades-long partnerships and recent commitments announced in October for manufacturing expansions with Amkor, IBIDEN, King Yuan Electronics (KYEC), Samsung Electro-Mechanics, SPIL and Unimicron. Those plans included an aggregate 2.5x increase in substrate capacity over three years, expanded advanced packaging, a doubling of semiconductor testing capacity from 2026 to 2027 and a 15x increase in SPILs optical-engine capacity by mid-2027, with aims for another doubling by the end of 2028. Our strong and long-standing collaboration with NVIDIA has continued to develop in the area of high-performance IC package substrates, said Koji Kawashima, president and chief executive officer at IBIDEN. Through the expansion of our Ono Plant, we will continue to strengthen our production capabilities and meet growing demand. Our work with NVIDIA demonstrates the value of close collaboration between chip design and semiconductor testing, said Gauss Chang, president at KYEC. Expanding our testing operations into the United States builds on that relationship and brings our capabilities closer to NVIDIAs growing US manufacturing supply chain. As AI reshapes industries and societies around the world, trusted partnerships and supply chain collaboration have never been more important, said SC Chien, chairman of Unimicron. The advanced substrate capacity investment underscores the strength of our partnership with NVIDIA and our shared commitment to support the rapid growth of AI infrastructure. By investing in advanced substrate technologies and manufacturing capabilities, Unimicron is well-positioned to help customers unlock new opportunities and share in the tremendous growth of the AI era. (ANI)

entries.title: La noche triste de Trump | Noticias
entries.paragraph_1: Como nos advirtió Heráclito, en este universo nada es permanente, pero incluso el filósofo griego se habría sorprendido ante la rapidez con la que cambian las cosas en el mundo político actual en que lo que un día parece inevitable puede esfumarse por  completo el siguiente. Hace apenas dos años, muchos analistas norteamericanos daban por moribundo al Partido Demócrata, cuya candidata, Kamala Harris, acababa de sufrir una contundente derrota en la contienda presidencial frente a un resurgido Donald Trump. Sin embargo, a pesar de seguir divididos y sin darse el trabajo de modificar sus propuestas, los demócratas lograron recuperarse lo suficiente como para cosechar una victoria espectacular en las elecciones de mitad de mandato de la semana pasada.
entries.paragraph_2: Desde entonces, quienes predijeron la inminente desaparición del Partido Demócrata están diciendo prácticamente lo mismo sobre el Republicano y, claro está, sobre el propio Trump, para quien los resultados fueron un desastre absoluto. Durante al menos los próximos dos años, demócratas sedientos de revancha, cuyo odio y desprecio hacia Trump no conocen límites, controlarán ambas cámaras del Congreso. Algunos intentarán someterlo a un juicio político con la esperanza de destituirlo, otros se conformarán con hacer todo lo posible por obligarlo a suavizar su postura en cuestiones como la inmigración ilegal -algo que, para sorpresa de muchos, dice estar dispuesto a hacer-, además de cohonestar las cuotas raciales destinadas a favorecer a minorías étnicas, garantizar los derechos adquiridas de las personas transexuales y otros temas que obsesionan a los activistas.

entries.paragraph_1: A China já não esconde que pretende incorporar Taiwan ao seu território. O presidente Xi Jinping acaba de reafirmar que a reunificação da ilha com o continente é inevitável . Mais do que palavras, porém, são os preparativos militares que despertam preocupação internacional. Tudo indica que a China está construindo, passo a passo, as condições para uma operação destinada a colocar a ilha sob seu controle, inclusive pela força.
entries.paragraph_2: Um dos sinais mais preocupantes é a construção, em território chinês, em uma área desértica, de réplicas de instalações estratégicas taiwanesas. Imagens de satélite revelaram uma reprodução de áreas centrais de Taipé, incluindo edifícios governamentais e o entorno do gabinete presidencial. Não se trata de simples treinamento militar. Analistas militares identificam nesses exercícios a preparação para uma operação de decapitação: capturar ou eliminar a liderança política e militar do adversário nas primeiras horas de um conflito.

entries.paragraph_2: Paris [France] November 12 (ANI): Foreign ministers of the Group of Seven ( G7 ) have expressed concern over China 's increasingly assertive activities in the waters east of Taiwan , warning that the actions threaten regional stability, freedom of navigation and the safety of international shipping, according to a report by Taipei Times. The warning was issued in a joint declaration published late Wednesday following a meeting of G7 foreign ministers in Paris. According to the report, China , which claims Taiwan as part of its territory, has intensified its activities off Taiwan 's east coast since June, conducting regular patrols by its coast guard. Taiwan ese officials believe Beijing is practising for a potential maritime blockade by deploying overlapping military, paramilitary and civilian assets in the surrounding waters. The G7 statement marked a unified expression of concern over China 's activities east of Taiwan . France, Germany, the United Kingdom and the United States had previously voiced concerns about Beijing 's actions in the area. " China 's increasingly assertive activities in the waters east of Taiwan threaten regional stability, freedom of navigation and the safety of international shipping," the joint declaration stated. The ministers also reaffirmed their opposition to unilateral attempts to change the status quo, particularly through force, coercion or the threat thereof.

entries.title: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO, CFO Colette Kress named interim CEO by board - Times of Oman
entries.paragraph_1: New Delhi : Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has opted to resign amidst mounting pressure, reported Reuters. Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress will take over as interim CEO as Nvidia looks for a permanent successor, the company said on Thursday. Huang has been in the eye of a storm after it was revealed that he had an affair with Alice Huang (not his relation) a Chinese businesswoman who is alleged to be a intelligence asset. Jensen Huang was also reported have had another affair with a senior executive of Nvidia Kimberly Powell. Jensen Huang had acknowledged his affair with Alice Huang in a letter to Nvidia employees where he apologised for being unfaithful to his wife and violating her trust. Nvidia's board had also initiated an investigation into the matter, with the inquiry being led by law firm Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz. In May 2026 a Wall Street 'Short seller' Culper research had flagged Huang's alleged links to Alice Huang. According to CBS News, on May 13 this year Culper Research published a 40-page report highlighting Huang's ties to Alice Huang, a former television reporter and financial industry executive. According to the report, a copy of which is with ANI, Culper research said, "Nvidia has repeatedly vouched for Megaspeed – its single largest Southeast Asian chip buyer currently under investigation by both U.S. Commerce and Singapore authorities." "Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has not only vouched for Megaspeed, but seems to have quite literally walked alongside Megaspeed at every step, while maintaining an uncomfortably close relationship with Megaspeed’s Alice Huang, a Chinese national. He was first spotted partying with Alice Huang in June 2024 – the same month the Apex/Alibaba pledge was filed. He then dined with Alice Huang in Taiwan in May 2025 – just weeks after the news of U.S. trade restrictions. Finally, per one current Megaspeed employee, Jensen visits Megaspeed-linked data centers “every few months” and “every single time” he visits, he is accompanied by representatives from Alibaba. The Megaspeed employee characterised their relationship with Jensen as “very close”, corroborating another former Nvidia employee’s suggestion to us that many Nvidia employees wondered if there was a special relationship," the report stated. Although Jensen Huang had got the backing of US President Donald Trump he was under extreme pressure with members of the US Congress flagging potential security risk of the affair with the alleged spy. Jensen Huang's exit puts the $4 trillion Nvidia in troubled waters and could potentially disrupt the AI industry which has been facing headwinds on the markets recently.
